name: Statistical Performance Benchmarking & Regression Detection
purpose: Design and execute deterministic, statistically sound performance benchmarks with warmup discipline, percentile reporting, and confidence-gated regression detection so performance claims are evidence, not anecdotes.
inputs: Benchmark harness and versions (go bench, pytest-benchmark, k6, hyperfine)
Target metric and budget: p99 latency ceiling, throughput floor, or startup cap
Load profile: concurrency, dataset size, warmup iterations, production traffic shape
Execution environment: pinned runner class, CPU governor, isolation guarantees
outputs: Measured verdict per comparison: delta percent, confidence interval, ship/no-ship recommendation
CI gate configuration enforcing the budget on protected-branch runs
Environment record and regression report with offending commit range
stop_conditions: All claimed improvements backed by confidence intervals excluding zero with A/A control green
Performance budgets wired into CI thresholds and passing on the protected branch
Regression root-caused to a commit range or formally accepted with owner and revisit date
